title: Backend Media Product Deepening
problem: Nako has strong local-media backend pieces, but migration baseline, identity onboarding, playback runtime sessions, and admin/media context links still need deeper product seams before mature Admin Web, Media Web, desktop, and mobile clients can rely on them.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-server -E 'test(admin_access) | test(local_session) | test(playback)' --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened backend product deepening lane after auditing existing migration, identity, playback, admin API, and reference media-server architecture.
Flattened SQLite/PostgreSQL baselines into direct current-schema definitions and added regression tests that reject historical replay fragments.

continue_policy.notes: Continue with BMPD-030 invitation onboarding, then Playback Session runtime and Management Context Links.
